name: LinkedIn
refreshNote: Inspect the URL with LinkedIn Post Inspector to refresh the cached preview; otherwise LinkedIn caches shared-URL metadata for about 7 days. Already-published posts keep their old preview.
notes: Official help article 'Make your website shareable on LinkedIn' (a521928): uses Open Graph tags (og:title, og:image, og:description, og:type...), og:image max 5MB, minimum 1200x627, ratio 1.91:1 (per search extracts; some third-party guides quote a 200px minimum width). minWidth/minHeight set to the documented 1200x627.

Behaviour change (2024): organic link posts show a small thumbnail image beside the title and domain instead of a full-width image; sponsored posts keep the large image. smallThumbnail=true reflects organic posts.
Feed card shows title and domain; og:description is not shown in the feed card. Title wraps to ~2 lines; truncation undocumented (null). A 150-char og:title figure appears only in third-party guides.
LinkedIn does not read twitter: tags. Formats: JPEG/PNG/GIF widely reported; webp support unclear; SVG not supported (estimates).

Verification method: official doc pages were located via web search (search-engine extracts of the official URLs listed in source); direct page fetches of the official domain were blocked from the research environment, so wording could not be re-read in full.
